items.t: Pre-catalyst breaks apart and scores the cylinders
items.job: Replace exhaust manifold with built-in pre-catalyst
items.note: If debris already scored the cylinders, a used engine or rebuild costs much more. Some 2002 cars had a recall.

items.t: Engine stalls at low speed from crank sensor signal dropouts (recall)
items.note: Software fix done free under recall; check the VIN. A failed sensor itself costs extra to replace.

items.t: Long cranking before the engine starts
items.note: Price assumes the pump's check valve is leaking down. Have fuel pressure tested before replacing parts.

items.t: Takata passenger airbag inflator can rupture (do-not-drive recall)
items.note: Free under the Takata recall, and dealers can arrange a tow. Check the VIN now.

items.t: Brake master cylinder leaks internally (recall)
items.note: Includes bleeding the brakes. Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: CVT whine, shudder or slipping
items.job: Replace CVT with a remanufactured unit
items.note: A used CVT costs less. A fluid change may help a mild case. Many add a CVT cooler afterward.

items.t: Battery terminal stud causes hard starts and stalling (recall)
items.note: High end is a whole positive cable. Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: CVT shudder, hesitation and failure
items.job: Replace CVT with a remanufactured unit
items.note: A software update or fluid change fixes some mild cases. Ask a dealer about any extended CVT coverage.

items.t: Passenger airbag turned off with an adult seated (recalls)
items.job: Update occupant sensor and airbag software
items.note: Software fix done free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Passenger seat belt bracket can bend with a child seat (recall)
items.job: Reinforce seat belt bracket and reprogram airbag units
items.note: Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Passenger airbag inflator may not deploy correctly (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Driver airbag inflator may deploy improperly (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Left front driveshaft not fully seated in the CVT (recall)
items.job: Inspect and reseat or replace left front driveshaft
items.note: If the CVT was damaged, it is replaced free under the recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Front tie rods can bend or break (recall)
items.job: Replace both front tie rods and align wheels
items.note: Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Door striker welds can break (recall)
items.note: Price covers all doors. Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Air bubbles in the windshield glass (recall)
items.note: Camera recalibration for driver aids may add time. Free under recall. Check the VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Head gasket fails on the 1.8L engine
items.note: Head should be checked for warpage; machine work is extra if needed.

items.t: Wipers can quit when the linkage joint wears out (recall)
items.job: Replace windshield wiper linkage and motor assembly
items.note: Free under recall 98V-093 on affected cars. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Tail lights are dimmer than the safety rules allow (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 98V-008 on affected cars. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front coil spring can corrode and break (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 00V-063 on affected cars. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear door impact pad may be missing (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 97V-110 on affected cars. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Crank position sensor can shut the engine off (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 01V-357 on affected cars. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Solder joint in the sensor circuit board can crack (recall)
items.job: Replace crank and cam position sensors
items.note: Free under recall 03V-455 on affected cars. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Steel wheel can crack around the cooling holes (recall)
items.job: Replace cracked steel wheel and remount tire
items.note: Free under recall 01V-277 on affected cars. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Lower control arm bolts can break (recall)
items.job: Replace front lower control arm mounting bolts
items.note: Free under recall 01V-174 on affected cars. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Engine computer box foam can corrode the circuit (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 03V-477 on affected cars. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Piston rings can let the engine burn oil (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 06V-223 on affected cars. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Positive battery cable end can lose contact (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 10V-555 on affected cars. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Dealer navigation unit battery can overheat (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 10V-401 on affected cars. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear camera image can be turned off and stay off (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 19V-654 on affected cars. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Right headlight may be aimed wrong (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 22V-244 on affected cars. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Missing cowl seal lets water reach electrical parts (recall)
items.job: Install cowl seal and dry affected area
items.note: Free under recall 23V-421 on affected cars. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Windshield bubbles can hide the VIN (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 24V-498 on affected cars. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Driver seat may not be fastened to its track (recall)
items.job: Secure or replace driver seat frame
items.note: Free under recall 25V-153 on affected cars. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front seat frame weld can be weak (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 26V-145 on affected cars. Check the VIN first.
